## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Related Issue

Reference at least one open issue here, outside HTML comments. Use `Refs #<number>` for related work or `Closes #<number>` when this PR resolves the issue.

## Change Type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Chore

## Validation

Describe how you tested the change, including the commands, environment, and results. State any checks you could not run. For kernel or model changes, summarize throughput, memory, and accuracy deltas and link the benchmark artifacts.

## Risk and Compatibility

Describe user-visible behavior changes, new required environment variables, and migration steps. Write `N/A` if none.

## AI Assistance

Disclose the AI tools used and the scope of their contribution, or write `None`.

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] Tests covering the change pass locally, or the untested parts are listed under Validation.
- [ ] Documentation and recipes are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] No credentials, private endpoints, or local build artifacts are included.
